items.title: 3 US Stocks Investors May Watch as Mega Cap IPO Fees Rise
items.summary: A blockbuster Anthropic IPO targeting a $1.4t valuation and up to $64.3b in fresh capital is about to test how much investors still love big-ticket AI stories, and it could ripple far beyond one ticker. Every major listing reshapes index weights, trading volumes, and ETF flows, creating winners and wallflowers. This piece zeroes in on three US exchange and market-infrastructure stocks that are most directly tied to that shift. The stocks covered next are just a sample at the top of this...
